title: Cross-device multiplayer join (2026-09-23)
description: phones and other devices failed to join a Mac host because peers used STUN only, Chrome/Safari mDNS host candidates are not routable off-box, the service worker could cache signalling GETs, and concurrent ICE posts could drop the only useful candidate. Joins now load TURN from `GET /api/signalling/ice-servers` (`ICE_SERVERS` JSON, coturn ephemeral HMAC, or static username/password), embed gathered candidates in the offer/answer, restart ICE once, treat WebKit `iceConnectionState` and data-channel open as connected, and show that ICE state on the join screen. Signalling logs record candidate type without player names, IPs, or secrets; the alias stays in the session blob for the host UI. The QR modal warns when the invite origin is localhost or not HTTPS. Cross-network play still needs TURN credentials on the Netlify function (`ICE_SERVERS`, or `TURN_URLS` plus `TURN_SECRET` or `TURN_USERNAME`/`TURN_CREDENTIAL`). Netlify had no function-log reader and no TURN env vars; historical joins could not be retrieved, and names are not written to new function logs.
verificationNotes: Archived completion. Individual manual QA results for this revision were not imported.

title: LLM through the player's subscription (OpenAI sign-in)
description:
An optional way to power the game's large language model features, such as voice-programmed automations (B-002) or LLM-driven AI, through the player's own OpenAI ChatGPT subscription instead of API quota or an API key. The player clicks "Sign in with ChatGPT" in the game's settings. That starts OpenAI's OAuth flow (Authorization Code with PKCE, a public client with no client secret, so it works in a browser game hosted on Netlify), and the player agrees to let the game use their ChatGPT plan. The game keeps the returned tokens only on the player's device, refreshes them automatically, and sends its model requests to OpenAI's Responses API with that access token. Usage counts against the player's plan, and the player can set a weekly limit for the game and disconnect it at any time in ChatGPT's settings. The game must never depend on this feature. Without a subscription, or when the player is signed out, everything works as now, and LLM features are either hidden or fall back to the existing route. Sign-in state, a disconnect button and clear errors (plan not eligible, limit reached) appear in the settings.
- Added 2026-10-17.
- Research (2026-10-17):
  - OpenAI: "Sign in with ChatGPT" is live. Go, Plus and Pro users can let participating apps use their plan with no API key. Plan usage is open to all open-source projects, which fits since code-for-battle is public. Closed-source commercial apps are only in a limited trial. The scopes are `openid profile email offline_access resource.invoke chatgpt.tokens.use.direct`. Docs: https://developers.openai.com/siwc/quickstart
  - xAI: there is OAuth sign-in for SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscriptions, used by Warp, Kilo Code, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. But xAI only accepts approved partner clients, so the game would need to be added by xAI first. Some tiers still return a 403 error after signing in. It's a possible second provider later, not something we can use now.
  - Anthropic (Claude): not allowed. Since February 2026, Anthropic's terms say Pro and Max OAuth is only for its own apps, and third-party apps may not offer Claude login or route requests through subscription credentials. Claude would only work with a paid API key.

title: Wrecks and recovery/recycling
description:
Ensure the units when destroyed do not just vanish from the map but their left overs keep lying on the map. The left overs should look totally color desaturated and slightly noisy to indicated dirt and damage (cache those desaturated images and reuse them). Any (also the ones from the enemy) left over unit can be pulled by a recovery tank to the base when player has the recovery tank selected and clicks on the tank. The the recovery tank will drive to the target then mount (indicated by a 2px black string that connects both units) and then automatically drive to the workshop where it unmounts and the unit gets fully restored but without crew.
  - 2nd option is that the user has the recovery tank selected and clicks on the left over unit while holding shift key. Then the leftover unit get recycled completely (vanishes from the map) but the owner of the recovery tank gets 33% of the value of the unit added to his budget (like a harvesting of resources). This process takes about as long as it took the unit to build. Show blue progress bar on the recovery tank while this mode is active.

  - Status: Wreck persistence and salvage landed in [424f9f5a](https://github.com/theSystem85/code-for-battle/commit/424f9f5a7db029e5c960a0b8040f6cd1bb8cdd60) (build v0.1.1), with workshop restoration changes in [44fd77b8](https://github.com/theSystem85/code-for-battle/commit/44fd77b80faf5812f30475b35ace5db96b7f27fa) (build v0.2.0). title: Performance
description:
Precompute SOT (Smoothening Overlay Texture) masks when map is loaded/mutated instead of examining 4 neighbors per land tile each frame.
  - [x] Created `sotMask` 2D array in MapRenderer storing precomputed orientation and type for each tile needing smoothening overlays
  - [x] `computeSOTMask()` generates the full mask once on initial render (lazy initialization)
  - [x] `updateSOTMaskForTile()` efficiently updates only affected tiles and neighbors when tile mutations occur
  - [x] `drawBaseLayer()` now uses O(1) mask lookup instead of O(4) neighbor checks per land tile
  - [x] Integrated SOT mask updates into `clearBuildingFromMapGrid()` for runtime tile type changes
  - [x] Exposed `getMapRenderer()` and `notifyTileMutation()` in rendering.js for external mutation notifications
  - [x] **Bug Fix:** SOT tiles now correctly update when loading save games or missions by invalidating the SOT mask cache
  - [x] **Bug Fix:** SOT now renders below ore overlays in GPU rendering mode by adding second pass for ore/seed overlays in `renderSOTOverlays()`
  - [x] **Feature:** SOT now applies to street tiles crossing water - water corner smoothening on streets
